texts.preamble: Hon'Ble B.S. Verma vs Sunil Kumar Bansal And on 10 September, 2013 Author: B.S. Verma
texts.facts: This writ petition has been filed for quashing of impugned order dated 13.08.2013 passed by respondent no.1 in case no.1/2013 Food Safety Officer, Laksar vs. Sunil Kumar Bansal and others (annexure no.7 to the writ petition) whereby penalty of Rs.1.00 Lakhs has been imposed upon the petitioner u/s 51 and 54 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006. Learned counsel for the petitioner has firstly contended that without proof of sale of sugar to respondent no.4 the Adjudicating Officer has wrongly imposed penalty upon the petitioner. Learned counsel has secondly contended that report of Food Analyst does not indicate what extraneous matter was found in the sugar. Issue notice to respondent no.4 returnable within four weeks.
